_note: Candidate models per agent role, in starting order. All ids come from the team's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LLM_BASE_URL, public list at /v1/models). The order is a starting guess; scripts/check_setup.py measures each model and the final order is set from its results. Evidence so far: Ultra and Super both scored 30/30 on the frontend routing eval (Ultra 0.86 s median first token, Super 1.57 s); glm-5.3 took over 80 s to first byte on the free tier.

planner_writer.needs: Strong reasoning, long outputs, follows citation rules. Used by the planner, the drill-down planner and the report writer.

lane_agent.needs: Tool calling and exact quoting, fast. Used by the 4 lane agents (news, company, legal, science) and entity resolution.

verifier.needs: Strict judge of whether a quote supports a statement. Prefer a different model family from the lane agents so their mistakes are not repeated.
